description: Build Android APK and copy artifacts to .lovable/ directory. Sync Capacitor and run Gradle assembleDebug.
steps: Run bun run build to produce fresh dist/
Run bunx cap sync android to sync web assets into the Android project
Set JAVA_HOME=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/21.0.2 and run ./gradlew clean assembleDebug --no-daemon in android/ directory
Create .lovable/ directory at project root if it does not exist
Copy all APK files from android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ to .lovable/
acceptance_criteria: Gradle assembleDebug completes and produces APK files
findings: All steps completed successfully. Vite build in 8.60s. Capacitor sync in 0.123s. Gradle assembleDebug in 35s. Produced 3 ABI-split APKs (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64) each approximately 3.6MB. Copied to .lovable/ directory. Gradle warned about deprecated features (incompatible with Gradle 9.0) and flatDir usage but build succeeded without errors.
